Pree, I couldn't find a ticket number for the West yard Door 2 double-booking at Marrow Fieldworks. I replied in your thread in #central-random.

I checked the channels you're in: #central-team, #help-it-ops, #general and #inc-tansley-carrier-api. None of them mention that double-booking. The only Marrow ticket I can see is PD-4821, which is about the Eastbank receiving-door import, so it's probably not the one you need. Hollis is the best person to ask, since he's handling setup and support for the Marrow rollout. The support queue should also have it if someone logged it there.
